Team — looping you in to build out the ground transportation plan for the Northbridge two-day exec workshop (Nov 18-19). Key constraints: three VIP execs arriving between 8:00–10:30am on day 1 (OAK arrivals), ~20 staff and engineers arriving across the day, and a product demo load-in requiring a small pallet + 3 flight cases. Venue has a single-level service entrance with 20' clearance.

Summary of asks: 
- VIP car service for 3 execs (door-to-door, meet-and-greet, luggage help) — prefer black sedans/small SUVs.
- Hotel shuttles or rideshare credits for staff (20 pax) with staggered arrival windows.
- 2 rental cars for on-call site leads (local insurance on file).
- Dedicated load-in window (Nov 18, 07:30–08:30) with reserved curb space and one parking pass for the AV truck.
- Valet routing / guest drop-off map for main entrance; venue will not allow long-term parking on the guest side.

Attachments: nb-workshop-transport-matrix.xlsx (details on ETA windows & preferred vendors) — please review. I need confirmation on vendors, budget estimate, and owner assignments by EOD Wednesday so I can include in the final events runbook.

Proposed owners: 
- VIP car service procurement & contract: Marissa
- Vendor ops point-of-contact & staging plan: Vivek
- Parking passes / venue coordination: Laura

Notes on compliance / receipts: client requires itemized invoices for any third-party ground spend; Marissa, please confirm finance routing for reimbursement and whether we should set up a PO (deal_id NB-3721).

Thanks — Hannah

- VIP car service: Prime Car Services (ops@primecar.com) is available and does meet-and-greet; they've supported our executive rides before. I'll introduce them on this thread and ask for a preliminary quote. Budget target: ~$650 per VIP roundtrip (airport-hotel-venue) or notify if that's off.
- Rideshare credits: I'll request $15 credits per staff rider to keep wait times low; will confirm total estimated cost once I have arrival window breakdown from your matrix.
